note: v2 (2026-09-26): measured on C3896 @ 5 s with a 0.01 grid on the 4K frame (see docs/scene_debug/manual_*.jpg). Normalized [0,1] coords of the reference frame; other videos are mapped through camera_alignment. lanes[] are hand-drawn (the 2 dominant flows); build_scene.py keeps its auto clusters under auto_movements.

traffic_lights.note: 3-lamp vehicle head on the median island, facing the camera -> controls the near (queue) approach. Validated: clean ~33 s red / ~36 s green cycles on all 4 videos.
2-lamp pedestrian head (standing-man red) at the left end of crosswalk_main_left. Not a vehicle signal.

no_u_turn_zones.note: UNVERIFIED legality: U-turn around the median end from the near approach into the far carriageway.

homography.note: Fitted by scripts/calibrate_camera.py (pinhole camera from ~12k pedestrian heights @1.7 m + lane vanishing point + 14 m stop line). World frame: origin = stop_line_near left end, x along the stop line, y towards the camera side. Valid over the whole road mask (flat-ground assumption).

lanes.note: Queue approach towards the camera, controlled by traffic_light_median. Direction = largest auto cluster (n=98).
Carriageway leaving the intersection, away from the camera. Direction = auto cluster n=44.
